title: After authentication, /user/getNetworkStatus discloses SIM phone number, cell tower ID (enabling… (CVE-2026-128795)
description: This vulnerability involves the /user/getNetworkStatus endpoint disclosing sensitive information such as the SIM phone number, cell tower ID, and network type after user authentication. The exposure of the cell tower ID can enable geolocation tracking of the user. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3.
